item.name: Service-to-service endpoints
item.description: Endpoints called by other services. The health check and the ExamPassed event go straight to a World Service instance (variable worldDirectUrl, internal port 3001 is not published in the team compose; publish it or run from inside the network).

exec: // Mint a service token the Gateway accepts: HS256, issuer player-service, audience kahoots-with-the-undead, kind service.
// The Gateway forwards its subject as X-Service-Name, which the service-only endpoints require.
const payload = encode({ sub: 'game-service', kind: 'service', iss: 'player-service', aud: 'kahoots-with-the-undead', iat: now, exp: now + 3600 });

request.description: Mints the service token used by the requests below that only a service (Game Service) may call. Uses the collection variable jwtSecret, which must equal the Gateway's JWT_SECRET (the team compose development secret by default).

Triggers the unlock of the zone that matches the achievement.

item.name: ExamPassed event (direct, from Exam Service) (2xx or 404 until implemented)

exec: // A new 32 character hex eventId (UUID v4 without dashes) per run.
pm.test('Delivered, or 404 until World Service implements the endpoint', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 201, 202, 204, 404]));
